ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Optical Remote Sensing Systems. Prerequisites: ECE 458, ECE 468, or consent of instructor. This course will introduce an overall systems approach for solving complex environmental remote sensing problems. Two systems, one passive (imager/interferometer) and one active (lidar) will be studied in detail. Special consideration will be given to system design, including instrument signal-to-noise and numerical simulations of overall system performance driven by real-world environmental measurement problems. Actual data from operating systems will be used in student exercises. This course is appropriate for graduate students who will either use existing systems, or design their own, for remote sensing research.
